lines.en: My legs are long; each step is high.
Forty points of armor makes for heavy going.
My stride is extremely slow.

lines.zh: 金属摩擦的声音一路跟着。
lines.en: The grinding of metal follows me.

lines.zh: 四十点护甲，可我不动手。
lines.en: Forty points of armor, but I do not strike.
I set a foot down and the ground answers.

lines.zh: 这东西不是穿在身上的。
lines.en: This is not worn; it is part of me.

lines.zh: 我一路走过去，草都压平。
lines.en: The grass lies flat where I pass.
This stone corridor has no visible end.
I walk it a stretch at a time.
The plates on my shoulder scrape the wall.
A white mark is left on the wall.
Only one shadow of mine falls under the lamp.
There is no sound inside the plates.
This frame has no need to breathe.
This floor is hollow enough to echo.

lines.zh: 我的护甲缝里没有声音。
lines.en: Not a sound comes from the seams of my armor.
Then I lower it again.
The lamps in the corridor are cold.

lines.zh: 灯影在我脚下分成两半。
lines.en: The lamplight splits in two at my feet.
My shadow falls on the wall.
The doorway reaches only my chest.
You raise your face toward me.
My head rides above your shoulder.
That thing in your hand.
It will not pierce this plate.
Try it if you do not believe me.
I am in no hurry to act.

lines.zh: 我的高个子挡住了灯光。
lines.en: My tall frame blocks the lamplight.
This place unsettles you.
Neither can I say why.
I do not intend to hide it.
I pause once.
There is a small dent in the plate.
Your hand should hurt more.

lines.zh: 我的甲发出很闷的一声。
lines.en: A dull sound comes from my armor.
I did not step back.
That one did not get in.
I turn around slowly.
Your weapon has dropped.
Pick it up.
I will not stop you.
Keep that thing.
I could not eat it at all.
There is nothing inside this shell.
You have held it up all this while.
Hold it long and the arm aches.
I will not reach for it.

lines.zh: 你举着的食物我毫无兴趣。
lines.en: The food you hold up holds no interest for me.
There is no stomach inside forty points of armor.
Keep it for yourself.

lines.zh: 你拿着它站在这儿很傻。
lines.en: You look foolish holding it there.

lines.zh: 没有近战伤害，也撞得你疼。
lines.en: No melee damage, and you still hurt.
I did not even rock once.
Give up a little of the way.
My armor will scrape you.
You hit me and bounce back instead.
Go around my side.
My shoulder is wider than a door.
You walk beneath my arm.
I hold my arm up in the air.
You need not thank me.
This is all metal.
There is nothing of that sort.
You asked the wrong one.
There is nothing under the armor.

lines.zh: 你想找的东西不在我身上。
lines.en: What you seek is not in me.
It is all hollow under this plate.
You can hear the echo.
Knock once and see.
I will not hold it against you.
Many have knocked on me.
That thing on the ground.
These knees will not bend.
My knees are dead.
Then you pick it up.
I look down for a while.
The thing is pitifully small.

lines.zh: 我踩过去也不会有感觉。
lines.en: I would not feel it underfoot.
I look down at it a long while.
It lies in a crack between stones.
My fingers will not fit in.
You have raised your weapon.
Then it has started.
I will not strike you with my hands.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，指向你的胸口。
lines.en: I raise my hand and point at your chest.
You will notice something wrong first.
By then it is too late.
My hand is already raised halfway.
I slowly close my fingers.
But you have not gone far enough.

lines.zh: 我在你身上做了点什么。
lines.en: I have done something to you.
I turn my head.
You are still standing there.
You are slower than before.
You have noticed already.
But you cannot say what.
I wait right here.
I stand and watch you circle.
You have not noticed yet.
Your hands have slowed.
That was not my touch.
You are still looking for a wound.
You will not find it.

lines.zh: 我的目光落在你的喉结。
lines.en: My gaze settles on your throat.
You are not imagining this.
Stand a little longer.
Your legs will give first.
I have done nothing.
I do not move an inch; I only watch you.
You have drawn half a step off.
It is too late now.
I watch you go down.

lines.zh: 四十点护甲，我一步没动。
lines.en: Forty armor, and I have not moved a step.
Your hands have started to shake.
That was not my hand.
That is the hour here.
Time here does not treat you well.
I raise a hand and do not bring it down.
This is not a blow.
Something in you is changing.
Your armor begins to weigh more.
I have not touched you.
My raised hand does not fall.
This is not done by strength.
You raise your face to me.
And I look back at you.
I lift a hand and hold it there.
My palm stops right before your face.
I shove your shoulder with an open palm.
My shadow falls on you.
You are bent down under it.
I have not raised a hand.
Your armor is growing heavier.
You know it yourself.
Your hands rise slower and slower.
I touched nothing.
You will not win this fight.
I come down the stone corridor.
Every step carries an echo.

lines.zh: 我身上没有武器，只有甲。
lines.en: I carry no weapon, only armor.
I come to a stop mid-corridor.
Who is in this place?
The lamps along the corridor are lit.
I walk down the centre.
The tiles change colour under me.
There is an old scar on my armor.
Someone else left it.
He did not finish this corridor.
I can finish this corridor.

lines.zh: 火在我甲上烧，我不觉得暖。
lines.en: Fire burns on my plate; I feel no warmth.
I fall and take a long while to rise.
Water seeps in through the seams.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的甲掀开一条缝。
lines.en: The blast opens a seam in my armor.

lines.zh: 一支箭撞在甲上，落了地。
lines.en: An arrow strikes the plate and falls.
That spell freezes me.

lines.zh: 我的肚子从来没有响过。
lines.en: My stomach has never once growled.
Lightning runs down the seams.
There is no ground beneath me.
